paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Feature pre-computation significantly improves the efficiency. The time cost for retrieval without feature pre-computation will grow with the exponential increase of paper number, while our proposed feature pre-computation stays unchanged and keeps constant time cost.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates time cost against paper number, apparently comparing the effect of feature pre-computation. The x-axis is labeled "Paper Number" and is linear, ranging from 1 to 256 with tick labels at integer intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Time Cost (s)" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. A blue solid line, labeled "w/o Pre-computation," begins at approximately 2 seconds at paper number 1 and increases to approximately 35 seconds at paper number 256. An orange solid line, labeled "w Pre-computation," begins at approximately 1 second at paper number 1 and remains relatively constant, reaching approximately 1.5 seconds at paper number 256.
